title: In 1989, Oprah Winfrey began a $25 million Morehouse Legacy
description: For over 35 years, Oprah Winfrey has made a remarkable impact with her $25 million contribution to Morehouse College, enabling more than 700 students to graduate while honing their leadership skills. The Oprah Winfrey South Africa Leadership Program immerses these scholars in the rich history and culture of South Africa.

title: Fanning sisters unite in ‘The Nightingale’
description: Elle Fanning and Dakota Fanning will share the screen in 'The Nightingale', a film set in World War II. The film is based on Kristin Hannah's bestselling novel and is directed by Michael Morris. It focuses on two estranged sisters who navigate the brutal realities of war together. Their different approaches to resistance highlight themes of family loyalty and resilience.

title: In 2025, Brian Cox backed the Glencoe Folk Museum, saved by women and set to reopen in 2027
description: Brian Cox is actively supporting the revitalization of the Glencoe Folk Museum, set to welcome visitors again in 2027. Established by determined local women, the museum aims to save historical cottages. A funding gap of £100,000 is currently being addressed to complete the project. When it reopens, the museum promises to display a remarkable collection, including items from the Glencoe Massacre, enriching the overall visitor experience.

title: Quote of the day by Jennifer Aniston
description: Reflecting on her vibrant career, Jennifer Aniston reveals a rich blend of achievements and setbacks in the world of entertainment. She openly discusses the hurdles she has faced, emphasizing her unwavering commitment to finding creative satisfaction. Aniston stresses the significance of tenacity and waiting in a business full of uncertainties, sharing wisdom collected over decades.

title: 5 K-dramas to add to your watchlist: From 'Good Partner 2' to 'The Blue Road'
description: There's a decent mix on the K-drama calendar this week, featuring new releases and a few returning favourites. A legal drama pairs two lawyers who couldn't be more different, a crime thriller teams up detectives from South Korea and Japan, and a murder mystery swerves into romance. If you'd rather have something softer, there's a countryside love story too.

title: 'The Brady Bunch' star Eve Plumb opens up about the realities of childhood fame
description: Eve Plumb, beloved for her portrayal of Jan Brady, recently shared valuable wisdom for aspiring young actors on a podcast. She urged them to prioritize honing their craft over chasing fame, warning that public attention could complicate their careers. Reflecting on her own journey, Plumb credits her supportive upbringing for her artistic success and has recently published a memoir, offering a glimpse into her creative life and experiences in Hollywood.

title: 'I Play Rocky’: Stephan James dropped 25 pounds and learnt to box to honor the Apollo Creed legend Carl Weathers; actor opens up about his transformation
When Gauri Khan revealed how she and Shah Rukh Khan respect each other's religion
description: Gauri Khan recently spoke about maintaining religious harmony in her marriage with Shah Rukh Khan. She emphasized the importance of respecting each other's beliefs while retaining their individual identities. Gauri explained that their son Aryan identifies with his father's Muslim faith, which sometimes confuses her mother. She clarified that respect for Shah Rukh's religion does not require her to convert to Islam.

title: 'I cannot just pretend': Rashmika Mandanna to learn Carnatic music
description: Rashmika Mandanna is preparing to take on the formidable challenge of bringing legendary singer M.S. Subbulakshmi to life in a forthcoming biopic. Committed to her craft, she plans to undergo formal training in Carnatic music, despite having no prior singing experience. Her initial hesitation stemmed from the immense pressure of the role, but under the direction of Gowtam Tinnanuri, this film aspires to honor the incredible legacy of M.S. Subbulakshmi.

title: Rob Reiner's six memorable films that continue to win over movie lovers
description: Plenty of filmmakers get stuck with one genre, but not Rob Reiner. He could have you laughing at a made-up rock band, then take you back to your childhood, then keep you on the edge of your seat with a courtroom drama. Being able to switch between genres like that made him one of Hollywood’s most versatile directors.He started as an actor before moving behind the camera, directing films with unforgettable characters, great lines and stories people really connected with. He passed away in December 2025, so it’s a good moment to revisit six movies that show off his range.

title: Taylor Swift hugs Jason and Kylie Kelce's daughter Wyatt as they cheer for Travis Kelce
description: At the recent Kansas City Chiefs showdown, Taylor Swift was seen supporting Travis Kelce, surrounded by his family. Cheering alongside her niece, Wyatt, Swift enjoyed the game where Kelce scored two impressive touchdowns against the Cardinals. Having attended five games this season, her commitment is clear. Notably, she also made a triumphant return to the CMAs, captivating audiences with her performance after a prolonged hiatus.

title: Ayushmann Khurrana recalls his childhood obsession with 'Maine Pyar Kiya'
description: Ayushmann Khurrana fondly recalls watching 'Maine Pyar Kiya' as a toddler during his uncle's wedding celebrations. His uncle received a television set and a VCR as wedding gifts which introduced Ayushmann to this iconic film. While 'Maine Pyar Kiya' is significant, his memories of 'Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!' are clearer from his nine-year-old self watching it in a theater.

title: 'Scene' BO day 17 vs 'Mookuthi Amman 2'
description: Scene has achieved a net collection of Rs 150.64 cr in India after 17 days in theaters. Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the film features Suriya as a police officer investigating an unresolved case. Mookuthi Amman 2, starring Nayanthara, has grossed only Rs 24.83 cr worldwide during the same time frame. The Tamil version of Scene has generated the majority of its earnings in the domestic market.
